title: Adjoint Matching through the Lens of the Stochastic Maximum Principle in Optimal Control
summary: Reward fine-tuning of diffusion and flow models and sampling from tilted or Boltzmann distributions can both be formulated as stochastic optimal control (SOC) problems, where learning an optimal generative dynamics corresponds to optimizing a control under SDE constraints. In this work, we revisit and generalize Adjoint Matching, a recently proposed SOC-based method for learning optimal controls, and place it on a rigorous footing by deriving it from the Stochastic Maximum Principle (SMP).
